_comment: Presentation only: nearby non-colliding leaf surfaces fade only when their per-instance projected bounds overlap the trainer corridor. A bounds test is conservative, not an exact leaf-depth/ray test. No placements, bake inputs, harvest state or colliders change. Validate native Compatibility motion before accepting.

near_lens_fade._why: F10#2 (coordinator, 13 Oct): the fight camera's lens entered Stormwood bark/canopy reaching past trunk colliders. Every surface of these tree models dithers out near the lens. Presentation only. TUNABLE. Attempt 2 (13 Oct): 1.5/4 m left giant canopies covering half of Capacitor's frames (judge 3/10); widened to 3/7 m and storm bush/fern added.

line_of_sight_fade._why: F10#2 candidate. Preserve supported StandardMaterial features and dither only fragments between the active fight camera and arena centre. Unsupported non-default features and custom shaders retain their original materials. No render-instance removal, collider, harvest, scale or bake changes. OFF until native shader validation and three-judge Medium/High review.
line_of_sight_fade._why_r2: F10#2 round 1 (three code-blind judges, CPU): this candidate 6.17 vs control 5.14, C3 6/6 vs 3/6. Remaining asks: canopy still washes the top of the frame (wider lens band and corridor while the candidate runs), dark arenas lose the small pilot (a soft unshadowed fill light follows the piloted creature). Presentation only.
line_of_sight_fade._why_r3: F10#2 round 2 (three judges, CPU): 6.14 vs round 1 6.17, flat; trunks still hide both fighters at Old Rodfolk's impact and the solver kept blocked orbits. Round 3 (clearly different approach): the fight-camera solver refuses a lens whose line to either fighter's torso meets world colliders (trunks, rocks), choosing a clear orbit; the fade keeps handling non-colliding canopy.
line_of_sight_fade._why_r4: F10#2 round 3 (6.60, CPU plateau): all judges asked that the pilot and the telegraph at its feet stay above the bottom action panel. While the candidate runs, the fight-camera solver keeps the fighters' render bounds 56 px clear of the HUD panels (12 px elsewhere).
